createTableDialog_privateDesc: Hidden from the table list. Share the link or code to invite players.
createTableDialog_createError: Couldn't create the table — try again.

ruleset_presetHkCasualDescription: Easier wins: 1 faan to win, capped at 13.

tablesPage_emptyHint: Start one and send the link to your friends.

practiceSetupDialog_hint: Tap a seat to cycle its bot's difficulty.
practiceSetupDialog_createErrorMessage: Couldn't start a practice table — try again.
practiceSetupDialog_easyBlurb: Builds toward any win; never plays safe.
practiceSetupDialog_normalBlurb: Aims for valuable hands and avoids feeding you.
practiceSetupDialog_expertBlurb: Learned from millions of self-play hands. Plays big and safe.
createTableDialog_fixErrors: Some rules need fixing before you can create the table.

createTableDialog_faanCapDesc: Scores stop at {count} faan, limit hands included.

createTableDialog_scoreTableFullSpicyDes: Points double with every faan: 3 faan = 8, 10 faan = 1,024.
createTableDialog_discardPaymentAllDesc: The discarder pays the whole win.
createTableDialog_discardPaymentHalfDesc: The discarder pays half; the other two pay a quarter each.

createTableDialog_handSetNew6Desc: Wins on the last tile, a kong replacement, a robbed kong or chained kongs.
createTableDialog_handSetsRequired: Pick at least one hand set.
createTableDialog_flowersEnabledDesc: Deal the eight flower and season tiles.
createTableDialog_flowersScoreDesc: +1 faan for each flower matching your seat.

createTableDialog_eightFlowersInstantWin: Drawing all eight flowers is an instant limit win.
createTableDialog_faanOverridesDesc: Change what a pattern is worth. 0 turns it off.
createTableDialog_overrideInvalid: Use a whole number from 0 to {max}.
createTableDialog_gameLengthEastOnlyDesc: One wind round: at least four hands.
createTableDialog_gameLengthEastSouthDes: Two wind rounds: at least eight hands.
createTableDialog_gameLengthFullDesc: All four wind rounds: at least sixteen hands.
createTableDialog_dealerRepeatOnWinDesc: The dealer keeps dealing after winning a hand.
createTableDialog_dealerRepeatOnDrawDesc: The dealer keeps dealing after a drawn hand.
createTableDialog_kongRobEnabledDesc: Win on the tile another player adds to an exposed pung.
createTableDialog_concealedKongRobbableD: Thirteen Orphans may also rob a concealed kong.
createTableDialog_wallReserveDesc: The hand is a draw once only this many tiles are left.

createTableDialog_claimSecondsDesc: Time to claim a discard: pung, chow, kong or win.
createTableDialog_handEndSecondsDesc: How long the result stays up before the next hand.

createTableDialog_provableFairnessDesc: Commit to each hand's shuffle before the deal and reveal it after, so players can check the wall wasn't changed.
